messages:
maria: hey — onboarding user hit a streaming stall in the sampleapp. stream stops after ~3s and we never get the final token. repro: run the node sample with streaming enabled. anyone seen this recently?

sam: which SDK and version? can you paste the exact call you used?

maria: using redwood-js 0.9.2, node 18. repro curl:
```
curl -s -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"stream":true,"prompt":"hello"}' https://api.redwood-inference.local/v1/outputs
```
response yields a few chunks, then connection close, no final token. no errors in client logs.

jack: hmm this smells like the auth refresh path. if token refresh triggers during an open SSE we sometimes abort+reconnect but the resume handshake sometimes misses the server-final chunk. @oliver any logs?

oliver: reproduced locally. server logs show: 
```
INFO  stream send chunk id=45 final=true
WARN  auth refresh start for key user123
DEBUG connection aborted by client (during auth refresh)
INFO  reconnect attempt -> resume_id=null
```
so final chunk was emitted right before the client closed and the resume didn't line up. client-side we get nothing.

sam: that explains it. timeline: token auto-refresh kicks in (client lib), we trigger a reconnect while server is still flushing final chunk — race condition. two possible fixes: (1) client should avoid mid-stream refresh (increase refresh threshold) or (2) server should buffer/anchor final chunk until resume handshake completes.

jack: short-term workaround: set env var in sampleapp to delay refresh: `AUTH_REFRESH_THRESHOLD=60s` or disable auto-refresh for long-running streams. longer-term: PR to server to make final chunk idempotent across resume.

deploy-bot: deploy: created canary PR redwood/streaming#502 that buffers final chunk until resume ack. running canary in staging. :rocket:

maria: thanks — adding note to onboarding guide and the sampleapp README about the workaround. will test canary tomorrow. :thumbsup:

sam: also adding a unit test for mid-stream token rotation. should catch regressions.

oliver: fyi this only hit users doing long streaming calls + short-lived tokens (~30s). rare but bad UX.

maria: good call. closing loop after staging verification.
